guarantees.claim: a_inv is always driven as the concatenation of a1_inv_buf[3] and a0_inv_buf[3]

assumptions.claim: mask_i must be independent from the actual input data (data_i ^ mask_i)
assumptions.risk: if mask_i correlates with data_i, the masking scheme will not properly hide the secret plaintext/key, enabling side-channel or fault attacks

assumptions.claim: prd_i must be independent of input mask mask_i for remasking and intermediate masks
assumptions.cond: when prd_i is used to remask or generate internal masks
assumptions.risk: if prd_i correlates with mask_i, the remasking step may not achieve the required independence, potentially leaking intermediate values or output mask

uncertain_points.claim: The assignment a_inv = {a1_inv_buf[3], a0_inv_buf[3]} appears before an endmodule, so it belongs to a different module; its usage and instantiation in the context of the masked SBox are unclear
uncertain_points.risk: a_inv may be unused or disconnected, leading to dead code or integration mismatch
